name: Trung An fruit
summary: Rambutan, mangosteen, durian, and jackfruit eaten from the trees at Trung An.
origin: Trung An, Củ Chi. Clause 129 put the old xã Trung An into xã Bình Mỹ.
howToEat: Eat rambutan, mangosteen, durian, and jackfruit from the trees. Young jackfruit salad and durian sugarcane juice are different plates.
seoTitle: Trung An fruit in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Rambutan, mangosteen, durian, and jackfruit from the trees at Trung An.
